dropped.item: The sorting is done by hand
'Every tonne in that 1,000 passed through someone's hands first'
The 'worn again' category is no longer listed separately from reuse and recycling (into something new)
Caveat that 1,000 tonnes is a small part of the textile waste out there (only a vague 'we've got a way to go yet' remains)
Explicit framing that the author wants to be clear the number comes from the sorting team

changed.item: 'Just passed' 1,000 tonnes became a milestone hit 'today', which pins the timing to a specific day
Credit shifted from 'your skill, patience and care are the reason this milestone happened' to 'what we've achieved together', which dilutes the sole attribution to the team

added.item: The team makes sure 'we find the best use for as much of it as possible'
Supporters believed in 'our vision for the new site'

invented_specifics: We hit a really special milestone today
